Addressing Non-Opioid Market Demand

MIRA-55 addresses a significant demand in pain management. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention data indicates that 24.3% of U.S. adults suffered from chronic pain in 2023, with 8.5% experiencing high-impact chronic pain that limited work or daily activities.
Grand View Research
estimates the global non-opioid pain-treatment market at $45.3 billion in 2024, projecting growth to $70.3 billion by 2030 at a compound annual growth rate of 7.7%.
In earlier preclinical testing, oral MIRA-55 normalized pain responses and reduced inflammation in a validated pain model, outperforming injected morphine in pain normalization.
MIRA considers this dual analgesic and anti-inflammatory activity a key market differentiator.
Clinical Development Timeline
Alongside completing dose-range studies, MIRA has progressed manufacturing scale-up and formulation efforts to prepare for clinical testing.

Pending successful completion of remaining IND-enabling studies and regulatory requirements, the company targets submitting an Investigational New Drug application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in the first quarter of 2027.
